what: When the top edge of a photo cell reaches 72% of the screen, a clipped surface (20% on every side) at .6× size in the center opens to fill the cell in .9s cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1), while the inner photo settles from 1.1× to 1× over the same time — once only. Even when used together with a parallax part, it touches only size and clipping, so they don’t interfere.

options.from: Initial size ratio of the opened face, default .6
options.zoom: Starting scale of the inner photo, default 1.1 — at 1 it doesn’t sink
options.round: Initial corner radius (px) of the cut face — becomes 0 as it opens, default 0 — fuji-gen 100
options.fade: Length of the fade-in from transparent (seconds), default 0 (opacity untouched) — fuji-gen 1.5
options.[data-fx-part=media]: (if present) inner panel that sinks — otherwise the first child

from.where: shared.js reveal() data-reveal="media"(three photos, news cards, article photo) — original media reveal clipScaleFrom .6 · mediaScaleFrom 1.1 · .9s
